nodes.description: Constructor of SimpleERC20; validates initialBalance_ > 0 and mints initial supply to _msgSender().
Internal token transfer that checks balances and mutates _balances for sender and recipient.
Internal mint that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account].
Internal burn that debits _balances[account] and reduces _totalSupply.
Internal approval that writes _allowances[owner][spender].
Public transfer entry point delegating to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Public transferFrom entry point; checks allowance and decreases it via _approve.
Public approve entry point delegating to _approve for the caller.
Increases allowance of spender by addedValue using checked addition.
Decreases allowance of spender by subtractedValue after a balance check.
Returns msg.sender, the untrusted caller identity.
Payable constructor performing an external payable call to the fee receiver.
Mapping of account balances mutated by transfers, mints and burns.
Nested mapping of owner-spender allowances.
Total token supply, increased on mint and decreased on burn.
Token name set in the ERC20 constructor.
Token symbol set in the ERC20 constructor.
Generator version string set in the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
Untrusted caller address used as the token owner/minter.
Unchecked-in-legacy arithmetic statement _totalSupply += amount inside _mint.
Arithmetic mutation _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount inside _transfer.
Arithmetic mutation _balances[recipient] += amount inside _transfer.
External payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName).
Constructor parameter for the token name.
Constructor parameter for the token symbol.
Constructor parameter for the initial minted supply.
Constructor parameter for the payable fee receiver address.
Local cache of _balances[sender] inside _transfer.
Local cache of the current allowance either in transferFrom or decreaseAllowance.
Local cache of _balances[account] inside _burn.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read directly and returned by _msgSender, making caller identity an untrusted input source.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the token movement.
approve uses _msgSender() as the owner granting the allowance.
Constructor mints the initial supply to _msgSender().
The untrusted caller becomes the account credited by _mint.
transfer delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine.
approve delegates execution to the internal _approve routine.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve with the summed allowance.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve with the reduced allowance.
currentAllowance is read from _allowances and compared to subtractedValue before subtraction.
currentAllowance is read from _allowances and reduced by amount in transferFrom.
Constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
_mint performs _totalSupply += amount, an arithmetic supply mutation.
_transfer computes _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount.
_transfer performs _balances[recipient] += amount.
senderBalance is loaded from _balances[sender] and used in the subtraction.
_transfer writes the _balances mapping for both parties.
_mint credits _balances[account] with the minted amount.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
_burn debits _balances[account] by the burned amount.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
accountBalance is loaded from _balances[account] and used in the subtraction.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
transferFrom reads and rewrites the caller allowance in _allowances.
decreaseAllowance reads _allowances to obtain the current allowance.
ServicePayer constructor forwards msg.value into the external IPayable(receiver).pay call.
The external pay call transfers control to an untrusted receiver that may re-enter during construction.
The fee receiver parameter determines the target of the external pay call.
msg.value supplied to ServicePayer flows into the external payable call value.
name_ is passed to the ERC20 base constructor to set _name.
symbol_ is passed to the ERC20 base constructor to set _symbol.
initialBalance_ is validated in the SimpleERC20 constructor.
initialBalance_ is forwarded to _mint and added to the total supply.
initialBalance_ is the amount credited in the _totalSupply += amount operation.

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is a constructor parameter only used to initialize _name via the base ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ is a constructor parameter only used to initialize _symbol via the base ERC20 constructor.
initialBalance_ is validated in the constructor and forwarded as the minted amount to _mint.
feeReceiver_ is a constructor parameter used solely as the target of the external pay call.
senderBalance is a temporary local whose only role is the sender debit subtraction.
currentAllowance is a temporary local used to compute the new allowance written by _approve.
accountBalance is a temporary local used in the burn debit arithmetic inside _burn.
